paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.01 as of August 25, 2026, with a change of 6.94% from the prior close and a change of -16.87% over a window of 22 sessions.

Fermi Inc. has had recent news coverage, including a headline from Stocktwits on August 25, 2026, in which cofounder Toby Neugebauer commented on the market's support for cooperation between him and the company's board as the stock surged to over a 3-month high.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a Form 4 filing on August 18, 2026, and a Form 10-Q filing on August 14, 2026, which reported a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, as well as the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, disclosed in an 8-K filing on August 13, 2026.
